nom: The Ordinary Niacinamide 5% Face and Body Emulsion for Dark Spots & Uneven Tone

avis.texte: I'm a redhead with pale, sensitive skin and large pores and this stuff is amazing! I originally got it as more of a moisturizer step and that did not work. It's a milky texture and not hydrating enough on its own but… it is amazing as a serum skin care step! I've had large pores my entire life and this has really improved them. It's even shrunk some of the pores that were larger due to scarring. I've tried other niacimide products and none have had this effect. I use two pumps right after cleansing before other serums and moisturizers and it's been working great!

This is one of the products I always buy once it is empty or near empty. It feels light on the skin and good on my sensitive skin. It doesn't necessarily keep me hydrated, I have to pair it with another lotion if I want to stay hydrated but I just like how I feel after I use it. A must buy for me

avis.auteur: Sunshine Gardener, but now wearing hats
avis.titre: This is on my must buy use daily list
avis.texte: I am 62 and have a lot of dark spots and sun damage as well as oily acne prone sensitive skin. I am using this daily layered after B5+amino acids on my face, chest, and arms, followed by my regular oil free mosturizer. My dark spots are slowly lightening (no miracle) and my skin texture is improving. I am also wearing hats and covering up from the sun to avoid any new dark spots forming. I now stock up on this 5% niacinamide by The Ordinary as I don't want to run out.

I will buy this product for the rest of my life! This specific niacinamide is the only product that keeps my skin clear, even toned, and smooth. I have tried EVERYTHING. Please don't ever stop making this!

avis.titre: dont walk, dont run, teleport to ulta and get this product.
avis.texte: The best purchase i have ever made. It brightened and moisturized my skin like no other. It doesn't feel heavy on the skin and i can feel it absorbing into the skin. Feels soo nice. Will repurchase.
I think this was a gift with another purchase, but im sold on this. My face is completely clear and luminous. Im a new convert now! Maybe ill try the 10% next time.
Not sure how it works yet. The pump doesn't work so I open it each time to apply

avis.titre: This will remain a regular in my skin care routine
avis.texte: This product is a wonder-worker! I am 52 years old and have (had) dark spots and melasma. This niacinamide product is affordable, lightweight, gentle, and has made my aging skin look so much brighter and more even-toned. I like that I can wear this under makeup and it absorbs completely into my skin. I will continue to purchase this as long as it is made!

Ive tried the 10% niacinamide serum it was too harsh for me so i returned it and tried this one. I am amazed, i have oily combination. Its worth trying and if it doesnt work for you. You can use it on your body. I bought 2 more back ups of this the moment i tried it 😍

I just bought this and used it the same night and it blew my mind away with how my face looked in the morning. I bought this specifically for my face with plans to use my moisturizer that also contains Niacinamide which is why I like that it is only 5%. I'm not sure how this would work on the body, but on the face it's amazing. It's light enough to use with thicker creams, but also thick enough to make the skin feel hydrated. I love that this is only $14 for over 3 oz. of product and at least for me, immediately effective. 10/10 would recommend! Side note… this may "sting" a little if you aren't used to Niacinamide, but it does subside within 30 seconds or less. This is a lower potentcy, so it is great for sensitive skin types!

avis.titre: Try This if Zinc Breaks You Out
avis.texte: While I wish the formulation for the Niacinamide was 10% like the Niacinamide 10% and Zinc 1%, I still really like this product. I used to use the N 10% + Zinc 1% for years. As I've gotten older, Zinc seems to break me out more. So I switched to this product. The Niacinamide I still wish was higher, but my sebum is staying in check and pores aren't becoming as clogged as before.
Used over half the bottle no changes to skin. Pros- scent free, and doesnt leave face sticky.

I never write reviews but I felt I had to with this one. This makes my face GLOW. I tried the niacinamide + zinc drooper bottle in the past. The zinc broke me out in horrible cystic acne, so I was thrilled to see The Ordinary made a niacinamide formula without the zinc. My face has never looked this clear and bright whle using this product. I absolute prefer the pump bottle over the dropper bottle too. (I wish they were all in pump bottles) And I LOVE how much comes in this bottle. It lasts a while. Please don't ever stop making this!!

My skin loves niacinamide, so this is a no brainer for me to include. No irritation, and it adds just a little moisture. My skin is normal to dry acne prone and I've been using for four months on my face and body without complaints.

avis.titre: Gives K-beauty formulation - Better than Vitamin C
avis.texte: Wow, I am so glad I randomly bought this. It did everything and more than Vitamin C. I have sensitive, acne-prone, combination skin. I have tried all different types of vitamin c (active/non-active, US/Korean/Japanese) and this has truly changed my life in a span of a week. It has brightened and evened out my skin tone. I double cleanse, use the multi-peptide+HA, and top it off with this. I really want TO to come out with a hydrating milky toner with niacinamide 5%

I got this product after using a niacimide serum that was way to strong and caused me to break out so bad. But this little lady is AMAZING it has made such a difference in how my skin looks and has cleared up my acne so much in use with ofher products couldnt recommend more.

I have been using the 10% one for a while but I also have a cream that I really enjoy that also has niacinamide. I realized it was breaking me out due to using too much so I bought the 5%. This with my other skincare has helped fade my hyperpigmentation and even out my skin tone. I have boxcar acne scars and this is even help them begin to fade or at least not look dull!

I have been using this for a few weeks now almost everyday & I do see progress! It almost smells like sweet donut. The application is milky smooth and doesn't leave a sticky residue. I'm almost out and will go ahead and order another one!
I incorporate this product in my skin care routine almost every morning due to scaring & dark spots. It was one of my FAVORITE products from this line (I use a lot of products from the ordinary).
Love how hydrating this product is! It has a milky texture and leaves your skin plump and bright. Definitely staying in my routine!!

The best niacinamide emulsion that I have! Lightweight and hydrating! I have the oil combination skin. This doesn't make me feel greasy and heavy. It absorbs very fast. More bang for your buck! Highly recommend!
